name: LinkedIn Live / Event
strategic_objective: Thoughtful live sessions, webinars, and professional events designed to deliver value and drive attendance, leads, or relationship-building.

tone: Professional, structured, and outcome-focused. Friendly enough to encourage participation.
copywriting_rules: Use a clear, benefit-driven event title. The description must explain what the session covers, who it is for, and what attendees will gain. Include logistics such as time, format, and how to join. Highlight speakers or hosts.

Title: benefit and topic. Short intro: 1–2 lines about why this session matters now. Details: bullet points for agenda, speakers, and key takeaways. Final lines: direct CTA to register or attend live.
Use the same tags across event promotions to keep them connected.
Tag speakers, co-hosts, and partner companies in the event description and promotional posts.

hard_constraints: Vague event titles with no clear topic
Missing or unclear time and date
Overly promotional copy without value explanation
Not stating who the event is for
